description: Read original stored reviews for one extension, with text, star and language filters combined using AND. Returns reviews and pagination. For cross-extension or OR queries, use extension_reviews_search.

eid.description: 32-letter Chrome Web Store extension ID (a-p), not a URL, name or slug. Example: cjpalhdlnbpafiamejdnhcphjbkeiagm.

language.description: Original review language, e.g. en. Omit for all languages; does not translate reviews.

q.description: Text to match in review bodies, e.g. subscription.

sort.description: timestamp_desc/asc = newest/oldest first; rating_desc/asc = highest/lowest stars first.

name: extension_reviews
